deepDive.title: Placed among the world's most innovative universities
deepDive.body: The World's Universities with Real Impact (WURI) ranking measures what universities actually contribute to society. In the 2025 cycle the University of Swat is placed in the global top tier for Visionary Leadership and recognised, again, for Entrepreneurial Spirit — the result of a deliberate turn towards applied research, incubation and regional problem-solving.
deepDive.quote: Innovation, in a mountain region, is not a slogan. It is the difference between exporting talent and exporting solutions.
